python range function returns.value: range object (lazy sequence), not a list

python default mutable argument gotcha.value: default mutable arguments (list, dict) are evaluated once at function definition, not per call

python __init__.py purpose.value: marks a directory as a python package; can be empty

python list comprehension vs map perform.value: list comprehensions are generally faster than map() with lambda in cpython

python __slots__ purpose.value: restricts instance attributes and reduces memory usage by avoiding per-instance __dict__

python set is unordered.value: true; sets do not preserve insertion order

python typing union syntax new style ver.value: 3.10 (use x | y instead of Union[x, y])

javascript nan === nan is.value: false (NaN is not equal to itself)

javascript == vs === difference.value: == performs type coercion; === checks strict equality without coercion

javascript event loop is.value: single-threaded; uses call stack, task queue, and microtask queue

javascript hoisting applies to.value: var declarations and function declarations (not let/const)

typescript strict mode enables.value: strictNullChecks, strictFunctionTypes, strictPropertyInitialization, noImplicitAny, and more

typescript any vs unknown.value: unknown requires type check before use; any bypasses all type checks

typescript interface vs type alias.value: interfaces can be extended/merged; type aliases can express union/intersection types more flexibly

typescript decorators status as of ts 5.value: stage 3 tc39 proposal, supported natively in typescript 5.0

javascript temporal dead zone applies to.value: let and const declarations before initialization

react virtual dom purpose.value: in-memory representation of the real dom; react diffs it to minimize actual dom mutations

react useEffect cleanup runs when.value: before every re-run of the effect and on component unmount

react useState setter is.value: asynchronous; state is not updated immediately after calling the setter

react key prop purpose.value: helps react identify which list items changed, added, or removed

react context api avoids.value: prop drilling (passing props through intermediate components)

react 18 new feature.value: automatic batching, transitions, suspense improvements, new root api (createRoot)

react useMemo purpose.value: memoizes computed value; recomputes only when dependencies change

react useCallback purpose.value: memoizes function reference; returns same function unless dependencies change

react strict mode double invokes.value: renders and effects are called twice in development to detect side effects

react error boundary is.value: class component that catches javascript errors in child component tree

nodejs lts release cycle.value: even-numbered versions become lts; active lts for 18 months, maintenance lts for 12 more

nodejs event loop phases.value: timers, pending callbacks, idle/prepare, poll, check, close callbacks

nodejs process.nextTick vs setImmediate.value: process.nextTick fires before i/o events; setImmediate fires in the check phase after i/o

nodejs require vs import.value: require is commonjs (sync); import is esm (async, static analysis friendly)

nodejs cluster module purpose.value: allows spawning child processes sharing server ports to utilize multi-core cpus

nodejs __dirname in esm modules.value: __dirname is not defined in esm; use import.meta.url with fileURLToPath instead

docker expose vs publish.value: EXPOSE documents a port; -p/--publish actually maps it to the host

docker host network mode.value: container shares host network stack; no network isolation

docker entrypoint vs cmd.value: ENTRYPOINT sets the executable; CMD provides default arguments (overridable at runtime)

docker layer caching invalidated when.value: a dockerfile instruction or its context changes; all subsequent layers are rebuilt

docker multi-stage build benefit.value: reduces final image size by discarding build-time dependencies

docker default container stop signal.value: SIGTERM; SIGKILL sent after grace period (default 10s)

docker volumes vs bind mounts.value: volumes are managed by docker and stored in docker area; bind mounts map host directory directly

docker healthcheck instruction purpose.value: runs a command inside container to determine if it is healthy

docker image layers are.value: read-only; container adds a writable layer on top

docker build context.value: the set of files sent to docker daemon; defined by the path/url argument to docker build

docker exec vs run difference.value: docker run creates a new container; docker exec runs command in existing running container

docker .dockerignore purpose.value: excludes files and directories from build context to reduce size and avoid leaking secrets

docker user instruction purpose.value: sets the user and group for subsequent RUN, CMD, ENTRYPOINT instructions

docker overlay network purpose.value: connects containers across multiple docker hosts (swarm/kubernetes)

docker copy vs add instruction.value: COPY copies files/dirs; ADD also supports URL fetch and tar auto-extraction (prefer COPY for simplicity)

docker scratch image.value: empty base image; used for statically compiled binaries with zero dependencies

docker run --rm flag.value: automatically removes the container when it exits

git default branch name (modern).value: main (changed from master; configurable via init.defaultBranch)

git HEAD refers to.value: current branch tip or current commit (if detached HEAD state)

git detached HEAD state.value: HEAD points directly to a commit sha instead of a branch ref

git rebase vs merge.value: merge preserves history with merge commit; rebase replays commits for linear history

git cherry-pick purpose.value: applies a specific commit from one branch onto current branch

git stash command purpose.value: temporarily shelves uncommitted changes so working directory is clean

git --amend flag purpose.value: modifies the most recent commit (message and/or staged changes)

git force push command.value: git push --force or git push -f (prefer --force-with-lease for safety)

git bisect purpose.value: binary search through commit history to find the commit that introduced a bug

git fetch vs pull.value: fetch downloads remote changes without merging; pull = fetch + merge

git tag types.value: lightweight (pointer to commit) and annotated (full object with message, tagger, date)

git hash algorithm default.value: sha-1 (sha-256 support added in git 2.29 experimental)

git submodule purpose.value: embeds another git repository as a subdirectory within a parent repository

git reflog purpose.value: records updates to branch tips; useful for recovering lost commits

git conventional commits spec.value: standardized commit message format: type(scope): description (e.g., feat(auth): add oauth support)

git sparse checkout purpose.value: checks out only a subset of files in a repository (useful for monorepos)

git worktree purpose.value: allows multiple working trees attached to same repository for parallel branch work

git blame command shows.value: last commit that modified each line of a file, with author and date

gitflow main branches.value: main (production) and develop (integration); feature/release/hotfix branches off these

git shallow clone flag.value: --depth=N; clones only the last N commits

git hooks location.value: .git/hooks/ directory; scripts named by hook type (pre-commit, post-commit, etc.)

sql null comparison correct operator.value: IS NULL or IS NOT NULL (not = NULL or != NULL)

sql inner join returns.value: rows with matching values in both tables

sql left join returns.value: all rows from left table plus matched rows from right; nulls for non-matches

sql group by requirement.value: all non-aggregate columns in SELECT must appear in GROUP BY clause

sql having vs where.value: WHERE filters rows before aggregation; HAVING filters groups after aggregation

sql index types in postgresql.value: btree (default), hash, gist, sp-gist, gin, brin

sql transaction isolation levels.value: read uncommitted, read committed, repeatable read, serializable

postgresql serial type replaced by.value: identity columns (GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY) as of postgresql 10

postgresql jsonb vs json.value: jsonb stores parsed binary (indexable, faster queries); json stores text verbatim

sql explain analyze purpose.value: shows query execution plan with actual timing and row counts

sql window function over clause.value: OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...) defines the window for aggregate/ranking functions

sql n+1 query problem.value: issuing one query for parent records then n individual queries for each child; solved with JOIN or eager loading

postgresql vacuum purpose.value: reclaims storage from dead tuples created by updates/deletes (mvcc cleanup)

sql foreign key constraint enforces.value: referential integrity: value in child column must exist in referenced parent column

sql on delete cascade.value: automatically deletes child rows when parent row is deleted

sql between operator is inclusive.value: true; BETWEEN a AND b includes both endpoints

sql upsert in postgresql.value: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (col) DO UPDATE SET ...

fastapi path parameter syntax.value: {param_name} in path string, typed in function signature

fastapi pydantic v2 breaking change.value: pydantic v2 (used in fastapi 0.100+) changes .dict() to .model_dump() and .json() to .model_json()

flask application factory pattern.value: create_app() function that instantiates and configures Flask app; enables testing with different configs

flask debug mode warning.value: never run debug=True in production; exposes interactive debugger (remote code execution risk)

flask blueprint purpose.value: organizes application into modular components with their own routes and views

django orm query lazy evaluation.value: querysets are lazy; database hit occurs only when queryset is evaluated (iterated, sliced, etc.)

django select_related vs prefetch_relate.value: select_related uses SQL JOIN (foreign key/one-to-one); prefetch_related does separate query and joins in python

django middleware order matters.value: request phase processes top-to-bottom; response phase bottom-to-top

django settings secret_key purpose.value: used for cryptographic signing of sessions, csrf tokens, passwords; must be secret in production

django migrations command.value: python manage.py makemigrations && python manage.py migrate

django rest framework serializer purpose.value: converts complex types (querysets, model instances) to python native datatypes for rendering to json/xml

fastapi lifespan event handler.value: @asynccontextmanager lifespan function replaces deprecated on_event startup/shutdown in fastapi 0.93+

http status 204 meaning.value: no content - success with no response body

http status 301 meaning.value: moved permanently - resource has new permanent uri

http status 304 meaning.value: not modified - cached version is valid; no body returned

http status 400 meaning.value: bad request - client sent invalid request

http status 404 meaning.value: not found - resource does not exist

http status 405 meaning.value: method not allowed - http method not supported for this endpoint

http status 409 meaning.value: conflict - request conflicts with current resource state

http status 422 meaning.value: unprocessable entity - request well-formed but semantic errors (used in rest apis)

http status 429 meaning.value: too many requests - rate limit exceeded

http status 500 meaning.value: internal server error - server encountered unexpected condition

http status 502 meaning.value: bad gateway - upstream server returned invalid response

http status 503 meaning.value: service unavailable - server temporarily overloaded or down

http methods safe and idempotent.value: GET and HEAD are safe (no side effects) and idempotent

http put vs patch.value: PUT replaces entire resource; PATCH applies partial update

http cache-control no-store.value: instructs caches to never store response; stronger than no-cache

http etag header purpose.value: opaque identifier for resource version; used with If-None-Match for conditional requests

http cors preflight method.value: OPTIONS request sent before cross-origin request to check server permissions

http/2 multiplexing.value: multiple requests/responses over single tcp connection simultaneously (no head-of-line blocking)

rest api constraint stateless.value: each request must contain all info needed; server stores no client session state

aws iam policy evaluation order.value: explicit deny overrides allow; default deny if no matching allow

aws region vs availability zone.value: region is geographic area with multiple AZs; AZ is isolated data center(s) within a region

gcp bigquery pricing model.value: on-demand: charged per bytes processed; flat-rate: reserved slots

aws cloudwatch logs retention default.value: never expires (must set retention policy manually)

aws rds multi-az purpose.value: synchronous standby replica in different AZ for high availability and automatic failover

aws s3 bucket name constraints.value: 3-63 chars, lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens, must start/end with letter or number, globally unique

gcp cloud storage classes.value: standard, nearline (30-day min), coldline (90-day min), archive (365-day min)

aws api gateway stages.value: logical environments (dev/staging/prod) mapped to api deployments

aws s3 presigned url purpose.value: time-limited url granting temporary access to private s3 object without aws credentials

oauth 2.0 grant types.value: authorization code, implicit (deprecated), client credentials, resource owner password (deprecated), device code

jwt exp claim.value: expiration time as unix timestamp; must be validated by recipient

sql injection prevention.value: use parameterized queries / prepared statements; never interpolate user input into sql strings

oauth pkce stands for.value: proof key for code exchange; prevents authorization code interception attacks

api key vs oauth2 difference.value: api keys identify applications; oauth2 grants delegated user authorization with scopes

github actions cache action.value: actions/cache@v3; caches dependencies to speed up workflows

github actions matrix strategy.value: strategy: matrix: runs job multiple times with different variable combinations

kubernetes pod definition.value: smallest deployable unit in kubernetes; one or more containers sharing network and storage

kubernetes deployment vs statefulset.value: deployment for stateless apps; statefulset for stateful apps with stable network ids and persistent storage

kubernetes liveness vs readiness probe.value: liveness: restart if unhealthy; readiness: remove from load balancer if not ready

kubernetes configmap vs secret.value: configmap stores non-sensitive config; secret stores sensitive data (base64-encoded, not encrypted by default)

docker compose depends_on limitation.value: only waits for container to start, not for service inside to be ready; use healthcheck + condition

github actions environment context.value: ${{ env.VAR_NAME }} for env vars; ${{ github.sha }} for commit sha

semver format.value: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; major=breaking changes, minor=new features, patch=bug fixes

kubernetes kubectl apply vs create.value: kubectl apply is declarative (create or update); kubectl create is imperative (fails if exists)

terraform state file.value: terraform.tfstate; tracks current infrastructure state; should be stored remotely (s3/gcs) in teams

kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaler met.value: scales based on cpu/memory utilization or custom metrics

github actions concurrency group.value: concurrency: group: ${{ github.ref }} cancel-in-progress: true; cancels duplicate runs

react 16 deprecated lifecycle componentW.value: deprecated in react 16.3; renamed UNSAFE_componentWillMount; replaced by componentDidMount or useEffect

create react app deprecated.value: create-react-app is no longer recommended; use vite, next.js, or remix

python setup.py deprecated in favor of.value: pyproject.toml (pep 517/518); setuptools still supported via pyproject.toml

flask 2.0 async support.value: flask 2.0 added native async view support using asyncio

moment.js maintenance mode.value: moment.js is in maintenance-only mode; use date-fns, dayjs, or luxon

kubernetes docker runtime deprecated.value: dockershim removed in kubernetes 1.24; use containerd or cri-o

next.js pages router vs app router.value: app router (next 13+) uses react server components; pages router is legacy but still supported

react class components status.value: still supported but not recommended; function components with hooks are the current standard

typescript 5.0 breaking change.value: some decorators behavior changed; experimental decorators now distinct from standard decorators

python asyncio.get_event_loop deprecatio.value: deprecated in 3.10 when no running loop exists; use asyncio.run() instead

fastapi 0.100 pydantic v2 default.value: fastapi 0.100.0 uses pydantic v2 by default with backward compatibility layer

aws s3 path-style access deprecated.value: s3 path-style endpoints (s3.amazonaws.com/bucket) deprecated; use virtual-hosted-style (bucket.s3.amazonaws.com)

webpack 4 vs 5 breaking changes.value: webpack 5 removed automatic node.js polyfills; adds persistent caching and module federation

python importlib.resources api change.value: importlib.resources.path() deprecated in 3.9; use importlib.resources.files() instead

openai function calling format.value: tools array with type=function, function.name, function.description, function.parameters (JSON Schema)

crewai tool hallucination cause.value: agents fabricate tool outputs instead of calling tools when tool descriptions are ambiguous or model is under-prompted

langchain agent tool name error.value: tool name in agent must exactly match tool.name field — spaces and case cause routing failures

json schema required field type.value: array of strings listing required property names

pydantic v1 vs v2 breaking change.value: pydantic v2 uses model_validate() not parse_obj(); .dict() replaced by .model_dump()

openai tool choice options.value: auto | none | required | {type: function, function: {name: str}}

python http status 429 meaning.value: Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded, check Retry-After header

docker compose v2 command.value: docker compose (space, not hyphen) — docker-compose v1 deprecated

async python keyword.value: async def for coroutines, await for awaitable calls, requires Python 3.5+
